data.purpose: Quota, token, credit, percentage, and timestamp values.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single highest-priority action in a local task group.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 32px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; padding: 0 13px; border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); font: 500 11px 'Instrument Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 88%, var(--ink-strong)); border-color: transparent; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A bordered or transparent operational action with lower priority.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 32px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font: 500 11px 'Instrument Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--surface-hover); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--line) 50%, var(--ink)); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Range Selector
components.description: A compact segmented control for the board's time range.
components.css: .ds-range { display: inline-flex; padding: 2px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface); } .ds-range button { min-width: 42px; height: 25px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); font: 400 10px 'Instrument Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-range button:hover { color: var(--ink); background: var(--surface-hover); } .ds-range button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-range .ds-range-active { background: var(--ink-strong); color: var(--canvas); } .ds-range button:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation Item
components.description: The active navigation treatment for the desktop rail and mobile drawer.
components.html: <button class="ds-nav-item ds-nav-active"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="3" y="3" width="7" height="7" rx="1"/><rect x="14" y="3" width="7" height="7" rx="1"/><rect x="3" y="14" width="7" height="7" rx="1"/><rect x="14" y="14" width="7" height="7" rx="1"/></svg>Overview</button>
components.css: .ds-nav-item { width: 100%; height: 38px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); font: 400 13px 'Instrument Sans', sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-item svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: var(--ink); background: var(--surface-hover); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-active { color: var(--ink-strong); background: var(--surface-hover); } .ds-nav-active svg { color: var(--accent); } .ds-nav-item:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Usage Metric
components.description: A compact capacity measure that keeps label, value, progress, and evidence together.
components.html: 5-hour utilization—Awaiting live quota data
components.css: .ds-usage-metric { min-height: 106px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 13px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--line-soft); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface-raised); color: var(--ink); } .ds-usage-icon { width: 38px; height: 38px; flex: 0 0 auto; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; color: var(--accent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-hover) 75%, transparent); } .ds-usage-icon svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-usage-metric > div { min-width: 0; flex: 1; display: grid; gap: 6px; } .ds-usage-metric small, .ds-usage-metric > div > span:last-child { overflow: hidden; color: var(--muted); font: 400 10px 'Instrument Sans', sans-serif; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-usage-metric strong { color: var(--ink-strong); font: 500 20px/1.1 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: -.03em; } .ds-progress { height: 3px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 99px; background: var(--line); } .ds-progress i { display: block; width: 0; height: 100%; border-radius: inherit; background: var(--mint); } .ds-usage-metric:hover { border-color: var(--line); } .ds-usage-metric:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Account Ledger Row
components.description: A responsive account identity and three-window quota summary without invented values.
components.css: .ds-account-row { position: relative; width: 100%; min-height: 88px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(190px, 1.4fr) repeat(3, minmax(96px, 1fr)) 90px 20px; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 13px 15px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-soft); background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font: 400 10px 'Instrument Sans', sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-account-row:hover { background: var(--surface-hover); } .ds-account-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-account-row:active { background: var(--surface-hover); } .ds-account-name { min-width: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; } .ds-account-name > span { min-width: 0; display: grid; gap: 3px; } .ds-account-name strong, .ds-account-name small { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-account-name strong { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-account-name small { color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; } .ds-account-avatar { width: 34px; height: 34px; flex: 0 0 auto; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 9px; background: var(--surface-hover); color: var(--ink); font: normal 600 10px 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .04em; } .ds-quota { display: grid; gap: 4px; } .ds-quota small { color: var(--muted); font: 400 10px 'Instrument Sans', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .04em; } .ds-quota strong { font: 500 10px 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; } .ds-quota > i { height: 3px; border-radius: 99px; background: var(--line); } .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; color: var(--muted); } .ds-status i { width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; } .ds-chevron { width: 17px; height: 17px; fill: none; stroke: var(--muted); stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-account-row { min-height: 124px; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); align-content: center; gap: 12px 10px; padding: 13px 12px; } .ds-account-name { grid-column: 1 / -1; padding-right: 94px; } .ds-status { position: absolute; top: 22px; right: 38px; } .ds-chevron { position: absolute; top: 21px; right: 12px; } }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: The compact modal field used for labels, groups, and protected account credentials.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: var(--ink); font: 500 9px 'Instrument Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-field small { color: var(--muted); font-weight: 400; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; height: 37px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 5px; background: var(--canvas); color: var(--ink); font: 400 10px 'Instrument Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-2); } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--line) 50%, var(--ink)); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-field input:active { border-color: var(--accent); }

components.name: Status Indicator
components.description: A text-and-dot status that never relies on color alone.
components.css: .ds-status-indicator { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; color: var(--muted); font: 400 10px 'Instrument Sans', sans-serif; text-transform: capitalize; } .ds-status-indicator i { width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; } .ds-status-indicator:hover { color: var(--ink); } .ds-status-indicator:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-status-indicator:active { opacity: .8; } .ds-status-pending { color: var(--muted); }

components.name: Unavailable Telemetry State
components.description: The honest replacement for a chart when model or cache telemetry is absent.
components.html: Telemetry is not exposed by quota endpointsSend observed provider usage to populate this view.
components.css: .ds-empty { min-height: 124px; display: grid; place-content: center; justify-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 24px; color: var(--muted); text-align: center; } .ds-empty strong { color: var(--ink); font: 600 10px 'Instrument Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-empty span { max-width: 280px; font: 400 9px/1.5 'Instrument Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-empty:hover strong { color: var(--ink-strong); } .ds-empty:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-empty:active { opacity: .9; }

narrative.overview:
The system treats account capacity like an operational ledger: exact, compact, and calm enough to remain open all day. True black gives the dark theme an unambiguous foundation, layered charcoal separates working regions, and mint is reserved for capacity and decisive action. The official CommandCode symbol is the identity anchor; the interface does not add a competing visual persona.

Information density is earned through alignment, quiet dividers, restrained type, and tabular numeric rhythm rather than decorative dashboards. The usage overview and account ledger are visually primary, while charts appear only when the product has observed data. Light mode preserves the same hierarchy with paper-white surfaces and darker semantic colors rather than becoming a washed-out inversion.
keyCharacteristics: True-black dark canvas with compact charcoal working surfaces.
Mint capacity signals, amber exceptions, and restrained token-series color.
Instrument Sans for interface language and IBM Plex Mono for measured values.
Thin borders and tonal layers at rest; elevation is reserved for overlays.
Official CommandCode identity, neutral account monograms, and no decorative portraits.
Responsive ledger behavior from wide desktop to the 320px minimum viewport.

rules.name: The Evidence Color Rule
rules.body: Mint, amber, coral, cyan, and violet must correspond to an action, a state, or observed telemetry; never use them as decorative fill.

rules.name: The Theme Parity Rule
rules.body: Dark and light themes preserve role and hierarchy even when their exact semantic colors differ.

rules.name: The Number Voice Rule
rules.body: Measured values use IBM Plex Mono; navigation and explanatory language use Instrument Sans.

rules.name: The First-Viewport Rule
rules.body: On the overview surface, do not insert decorative modules between fleet usage and the account ledger.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Ordinary panels and metrics use borders and tonal contrast; shadows only communicate a covering layer.

rules.name: The Nested Radius Rule
rules.body: Smaller elements inside a surface always use a tighter radius than their container.

dos: Do keep the official CommandCode symbol and product name as the only brand identity in the shell.
Do make remaining capacity, reset timing, and account state readable before secondary analytics.
Do use neutral monograms derived from account labels for private, stable account recognition.
Do preserve full dark/light semantic parity and keyboard-visible focus.
Do use “Not observed,” an em dash, or an explanatory empty state when provider data is absent.
Do preserve the overview-to-account-ledger sequence and the 320px operating floor.
donts: Don't fabricate model, cache, request, cost, success, or historical usage values to fill visual space.
Don't expose raw API keys, credentials, or local-vault contents in visual examples or interface copy.
Don't add decorative gradients, glow, glass cards, or generic dashboard acreage to the true-black ledger.
Don't use generated human faces for accounts or replace the official CommandCode symbol with a concept mark.
Don't let microtype, status actions, or disclosure controls collide at narrow widths.
Don't add an eyebrow or slogan above the compact top-bar title.
